annotations.title: Merchant cash advance cost and APR

description: Turns a merchant cash advance's factor rate and payment schedule into total payback, dollar cost and APR, and shows how the APR moves if it is repaid faster or slower. An estimate from the inputs, not a quote.

fees.description: Fees taken from the advance, in dollars (optional)

months.description: Expected months to repay, up to 60

schedule.description: Payment schedule. Default daily (252 business days a year)

name: calculate_mca_true_cost
title: Merchant cash advance cost and APR
